text:
anya: Heads up — we're planning a coordinated deprecation for legacy SDK v2 across cloud marketplaces, HW partners, and a few SI integrations. Need a simple partner-facing visualization + comms timeline (one pager) that shows: 1) deprecation milestones (announce, 90/60/30d notices, sunset), 2) marketplace-specific windows, 3) SI contract lead times, 4) fallback/shim availability. Who can own the timeline + exportable graphic?

mike: I can own the viz. can someone drop the canonical list of impacted marketplaces + partners? 

jordan: FYI marketplace legal requires at least 45 days notice for listing changes; systems integrators we've contracted with usually need 90–120 days depending on SLA. list: AWS Marketplace, GCP Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, Rackspace SI, Sigma Integrations (SI).

sophia: I'll draft partner comms and an FAQ. quick ask: do we want a single global sunset date or staggered by marketplace?

olga: Recommend staggered: marketplaces have different review cycles and app re-approval times. Also include a compatibility shim for customers on private deployments for at least 6 months. note: include migration guide links and example code snippets.

mike: Proposal from eng: staggered rollout by region+marketplace. rough schedule below (we can polish):
```csv
phase,days_before_sunset,notes
announce,120,internal + public blog post
notice_90,90,partner email + marketplace notice
notice_60,60,in-app banner + partner AM outreach
notice_30,30,escalation to account teams
sunset,0,remove v2 from listings and block new installs
```

anya: That looks good. Sophia — can you add a short paragraph for each phase (what partner sees, what we do)? olga — can you confirm whether marketplace listings allow the 120-day public announce?

olga: Confirmed for Azure and GCP; AWS needs a pre-review, so treat AWS as 150-day public announce. add a note for AWS dependency review.

jordan: Also flag any hardware partners that bundle SDKs (e.g., EdgeBox v1) — they may need firmware updates. I'll get a list by EOD.

sophia: Draft FAQ checklist I'm putting together: migration steps, shim availability, how to opt into extended support, rollback policy, partner support contact list. sharing draft: https://docs.google.com/draft-deprecation-comms (will post real link once ready) :memo:

mike: For the viz file format, prefer SVG + PNG + CSV export. I'll make a timeline component that can be embedded in the partner portal.

partners-bot: Created calendar event "Deprecation Coordination — partners" for 2026-04-02 10:00am PT. Attendees: anya, mike, sophia, olga, jordan.

anya: Great — thanks everyone. Action items: mike -> initial viz mock by tomorrow; jordan -> hardware/SI impact list by EOD; sophia -> comms draft by EOD; olga -> confirm AWS pre-review ticket owner. We'll iterate in the meeting on Apr 2. :rocket:
